then.description: Add the following to your Roguish Skills.

else.description: You don't have the **Tricks of the Trade** Rogue Starting Move, so you gain it, but only with these two Skills. For each Skill that is redundant, work with the GM to create a new one.

submoves.title: Tricks of the Trade
submoves.description: When you **Defy Danger** or **Sneak Past** by applying one of your Roguish Skills, you cheat; roll with 1d8+1d6 (instead of 2d6).

submoves.title: Smooth Operator
submoves.description: When you **disguise yourself as someone else**, gain Mask equal to your CHA (min 1). You can spend Mask, 1-for-1, to automatically overcome scrutiny. When you reach 0 Mask, roll+CHA.

outcomes.text: They're none the wiser; gain 1 Mask.
Someone suspects you; the GM will say who.
your cover is blown; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Hand Trick
description: When you leave a room or other location, you can name something small that you saw that no one else was using or playing particular attention to. You took it with you.

title: Maven Saboteur
description: When you **reveal that you've used a disguise to previously sabotage or nullify an obstacle or mechanism**, right as it becomes relevant, roll+CHA.

outcomes.text: It goes off with a bang, creating the perfect opportunity.
The opportunity is fleeting—act now or it'll be too late.
A tiny overlooked detail becomes a huge problem; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Underworld Connections
description: When you **put the word out that you're looking for something**, roll+cha. No matter the result, someone comes back to you with a lead.

bullets: It's not quite right; the GM will say how *after* you choose this
Someone who doesn't know or like you has it
You'll owe someone a steep debt to get it. Until you repay them you get **dis** on this move and can't choose this option again

outcomes.text: The lead might be a fake, a trap, or already be claimed by an enemy; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: You Know My Name
description: When you **first meet someone who's heard of you** (your call), roll+cha.

outcomes.text: Tell the GM two things they've heard about you.
Tell the GM one thing, and the GM tells you the other.
you won't like what they've heard; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
